name: Certain Deception (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 6

Benefit: A saboteur with this trick can persuade and deceive her marked targets more easily. Once during the duration of her charlatan’s mark, she can reroll a Bluff, Diplomacy, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth check she made against her target, or reroll a Bluff or Disguise check she made to pass her self as her marked target. She can only do this once per target she marks with her charlatan’s mark in a 24 hour period, and must take the second roll, even if it is worse.
